final: WITH dc AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS t FROM dc) SELECT region, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT t FROM tot)) AS avg_share FROM dc GROUP BY region
